grammar_title: 动名词(-ing 形式)作宾语和表语
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 4 Discovering Useful Structures:动名词作动词宾语 / 介词宾语 / 表语。句子围绕肢体语言主题、地道,只有 -ing 动名词形式因动词或介词的固定搭配而唯一成立(干扰项 to do / done / 原形均不合)。

points.point: 动名词作动词宾语(enjoy/finish/mind/avoid/keep/practise/suggest/consider/imagine/can't help + doing)
points.overview: 某些动词后只能接动名词作宾语:enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, keep, practise, suggest, consider, imagine, can't help, give up, miss 等 + doing;不接不定式或原形。

points.point: 动名词作介词宾语(be good at / look forward to / be used to / be interested in / instead of / thank sb for + doing)
points.overview: 介词后接动名词作其宾语:at/to/in/of/for/about/on 等介词(含 look forward to, be/get used to, instead of, thank sb for)+ doing。

points.point: 动名词作表语(My job is teaching. / Seeing is believing.)
points.overview: 系动词 be 后用动名词作表语,说明主语的内容/性质(My job is teaching.);区别于不定式作表语和现在分词作定语/状语。

questions.stem: She enjoys ____ about body language in different cultures.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后只接动名词作宾语 → learning。

questions.stem: You should avoid ____ this "OK" gesture in Brazil, as it is not polite.
questions.explanation: avoid 后接动名词 → making。

questions.stem: When she felt embarrassed, she could not help ____ her face in her hands.
questions.explanation: can't help 后接动名词 → hiding。

questions.stem: Experts suggest ____ at yourself in the mirror to feel happier.
questions.explanation: suggest 后接动名词 → smiling。

questions.stem: The shy student kept ____ eye contact with the teacher.
questions.explanation: keep 后接动名词 → avoiding。

questions.stem: Would you mind ____ your hand circles over your stomach to show "I'm full"?
questions.explanation: mind 后接动名词 → moving。

questions.stem: Actors practise ____ feelings with only their faces and hands.
questions.explanation: practise 后接动名词 → showing。

questions.stem: Have you finished ____ the table about gestures on page 39?
questions.explanation: finish 后接动名词 → filling。

questions.stem: Please imagine ____ someone too long; it can feel like a threat.
questions.explanation: imagine 后接动名词 → staring at。

questions.stem: The teacher considered ____ class activities to suit shy students.
questions.explanation: consider 后接动名词 → changing。

questions.stem: Some students enjoy ____ out of the window while daydreaming.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词 → staring。

questions.stem: He never gives up ____ to read people's faces correctly.
questions.explanation: give up 后接动名词 → trying。

questions.stem: Avoid ____ your arms in front of your chest if you want to look open.
questions.explanation: avoid 后接动名词 → crossing。

questions.stem: When we feel proud, we can't help ____ ourselves to look bigger.
questions.explanation: can't help 后接动名词 → straightening。

questions.stem: She kept ____ slightly forward to show she was interested.
questions.explanation: keep 后接动名词 → leaning。

questions.stem: I really miss ____ my friends nod and smile when we talk.
questions.explanation: miss 后接动名词 → seeing。

questions.stem: Would you mind ____ down a little when you greet the elder?
questions.explanation: mind 后接动名词 → bowing。

questions.stem: The teacher suggested ____ distracted students that they pay attention.
questions.explanation: suggest 后接动名词 → reminding。

questions.stem: He practised ____ his face calm so others could not read his feelings.
questions.explanation: practise 后接动名词 → keeping。

questions.stem: Powerful people often consider ____ a confident pose before a speech.
questions.explanation: consider 后接动名词 → holding。

questions.stem: She is good at ____ what people feel from their faces.
questions.explanation: be good at 后接动名词作介词宾语 → reading。

questions.stem: We look forward to ____ how body language differs around the world.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中 to 是介词,后接动名词 → learning。

questions.stem: In Japan, you can show respect instead of ____ straight into an elder's eyes.
questions.explanation: instead of 后接动名词 → looking。

questions.stem: Many international students are interested in ____ Chinese gestures.
questions.explanation: be interested in 后接动名词 → understanding。

questions.stem: After years abroad, he is used to ____ hands when he meets someone.
questions.explanation: be used to(习惯于)中 to 是介词,后接动名词 → shaking。

questions.stem: Thank you for ____ me how to read a fake smile.
questions.explanation: thank sb for 后接动名词 → teaching。

questions.stem: A smile is a simple way of ____ down barriers between strangers.
questions.explanation: way of 后接动名词 → breaking。

questions.stem: She apologised by ____ her head and lowering her eyes.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后接动名词 → bowing。

questions.stem: He kept silent for a while before ____ his real feelings.
questions.explanation: 介词 before 后接动名词 → revealing。

questions.stem: We learn about feelings by ____ at people's gestures and faces.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后接动名词 → looking。

questions.stem: They are good at ____ a real smile from a fake one.
questions.explanation: be good at 后接动名词 → distinguishing。

questions.stem: She is interested in ____ how Chinese people use body language.
questions.explanation: be interested in 后接动名词 → learning。

questions.stem: Instead of ____, the worried student crossed his arms tightly.
questions.explanation: instead of 后接动名词 → relaxing。

questions.stem: Our teacher is used to ____ when we are interested or bored.
questions.explanation: be used to(习惯于)后接动名词 → noticing。

questions.stem: He got through the difficult talk by ____ at himself in the mirror first.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后接动名词 → smiling。

questions.stem: We look forward to ____ the art of non-verbal humour in the film.
questions.explanation: look forward to 后接动名词 → appreciating。

questions.stem: Thank you for ____ me the difference between these two gestures.
questions.explanation: thank sb for 后接动名词 → showing。

questions.stem: She is good at ____ what each pose is telling us.
questions.explanation: be good at 后接动名词 → interpreting。

questions.stem: He showed respect by ____ his head when talking to the old man.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后接动名词 → lowering。

questions.stem: Instead of ____, she chose to nod and let her body do the talking.
questions.explanation: instead of 后接动名词 → speaking。

questions.stem: The crucial thing is ____ body language in a way that suits the culture.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,说明主语 the thing 的内容 → using。

questions.stem: His job is ____ sign language to deaf children.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语,说明 his job 是什么 → teaching。

questions.stem: Seeing is ____; we trust what a person's face shows us.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语(Seeing is believing 谚语)→ believing。

questions.stem: One good way of saying "I'm full" is ____ your hand over your stomach.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语,说明 the way 是什么 → moving。

questions.stem: The main thing is ____ distracted students that they need to focus.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → reminding。

questions.stem: My duty as a teacher is ____ every student to learn well.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语,说明 my duty 的内容 → helping。

questions.stem: The theme of his presentation is ____ down barriers between groups.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → breaking。

questions.stem: Her favourite activity in class is ____ out of the window.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语,说明 activity 的内容 → staring。

questions.stem: What a smile can do is ____ us through difficult situations.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → helping。

questions.stem: The best example of useful body language is ____ at others.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → smiling。

questions.stem: A teacher's real skill is ____ when a student is troubled.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语,说明 skill 的内容 → perceiving。

questions.stem: One sign of being proud is ____ up to make yourself look bigger.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → straightening。

questions.stem: The hardest part of the job is ____ when students are really troubled.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → distinguishing。

questions.stem: What worried students often do is ____ their arms in front of them.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → crossing。

questions.stem: A polite greeting in Japan is ____ from the waist.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → bowing。

questions.stem: His habit when bored is ____ his chin on his hand.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → resting。

questions.stem: The first step in reading people is ____ at their faces carefully.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → looking。

questions.stem: A common way to say "sleep" is ____ your hands by your head.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → placing。

questions.stem: Her real talent is ____ a fake smile in a single second.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → spotting。

questions.stem: The point of the lesson is ____ feelings without using any words.
questions.explanation: 动名词作表语 → expressing。
